reason: My main Instagram is my storefront, and this wants to send DMs from it through an extension. Nothing on the page shows it has ever been safe or gotten anyone a booked call. 'No customer results published yet' plus a card-required trial that turns into final payments on day 4 reads like a trap to me.
objection: If this gets my main account flagged or restricted I lose months of content and clients, and there's no proof from a single real user that it works or that accounts survive. Add 'payments are final' after a 3-day trial and I'd be the one taking all the risk.
would_change_my_mind: A few named coaches or agency owners, on camera, showing booked calls and their accounts still fine after months. Plus a refund window of 14 to 30 days instead of 'payments are final'.
